visualCharacteristics.purpose: Region explorer: vertical tabs, each panel showing a map with numbered hotspot links, a stat grid, body copy and an arrow link
notes: Dark (#343538) panel with intro video and cloud/satellite map imagery behind; left vertical tab list (About Us / Our Region / Our Nature) with gold active underline; centre map with numbered region hotspots; right column of gold stat values with uppercase captions, paragraph and arrow link. Photo/video background belongs to the block, so section not colored.

contentPattern.structure: optional single-cell rows for intro heading or background image; then one row per tab: cell 1 = tab label, cell 2 = map image, bulleted list of hotspot links, stat paragraphs (bold value + caption), paragraph, arrow link
patterns: map image with numbered hotspot links
blockContent: 3 tab panels (About Us, Our Region, Our Nature); each: map image, region/landscape hotspot links (Trojena, THE LINE, Oxagon, Islands of NEOM, Magna / Marine Landscapes, Lower Desert, Mountain, Upper Valley), 4 stats (value + caption), paragraph, arrow link

usage.description: Tabbed overview with map and key figures.

reuseGuidance: Use when each tab pairs a map/visual with stats. Use plain tabs for text-only panels.
